column15: Ferdia Therapeutics is a San Diego-based biotechnology company focused on the development of long-acting peptide therapeutics designed for convenient once-weekly dosing through a patient-friendly multi-use pen device. The company aims to enhance the efficacy and usability of peptide medications by employing half-life extension strategies to create novel peptides with superior potency, solubility, and selectivity.
